fields.subject: Grain Persistence
fields.response: default ShardSetKey to the default Orleans storage provider name, default ValidateGrainKeys to true, start Queries as an empty dictionary, and default InitStage to ServiceLifecycleStage.ApplicationServices
fields.postcondition: each provider instance's own ValidateGrainKeys value governs its writes and clears: ArgentSeaShardGrainPersistence caches its compiled write and clear delegates per (state name, state type, ValidateGrainKeys) triple, so providers configured differently never share a delegate, and neither do state types that share a state name
